source.text: וַיּוֹצִאֵ֗נִי אֶל־הֶֽחָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֑וֹן וַיְבִאֵ֣נִי אֶל־הַלִּשְׁכָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נֶ֧גֶד הַגִּזְרָ֛ה וַאֲשֶֽׁר־נֶ֥גֶד הַבִּנְיָ֖ן אֶל־הַצָּפֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And he brought me out to the court the outer, the way [the] way of the north, and he brought me to the room which [was] opposite the separate area and which [was] opposite the building to the north.

en.L: Then he brought me out into the outer court, by the way toward the north, and he brought me to the chambers that [were] opposite the separate area and opposite the building toward the north.
en.B: Then he led me out into the outer court on the north side and brought me to the rooms opposite the separate area and opposite the building on the north.
en.R: Then the man led me out to the outer courtyard on the north side. He took me to the rooms across from the separate area and from the building on the north side.

pt.L: Então ele me fez sair para o átrio exterior, pelo caminho que vai para o norte, e me levou às câmaras que [ficavam] defronte da área separada e defronte do edifício, para o norte.
pt.B: Depois ele me conduziu para fora, ao átrio exterior, no lado norte, e me levou às salas que ficavam defronte da área separada e defronte do edifício, no norte.
pt.R: Depois o homem me levou para fora, ao pátio externo, no lado norte. Ele me levou às salas que ficavam em frente à área separada e ao edifício do lado norte.

decisions.choice: the room: a block of rooms
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has the singular "room", used as a collective for the block of rooms described in verses 2-12. They are the holy rooms of the priests (verse 13).

decisions.choice: the separate area: as in 41:12
decisions.reason: The rooms lie north of the open area around the temple building and of the building on the west (41:12-15).

decisions.choice: chambers (L); rooms (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 40:17. The singular is read as a collective (m1).

source.text: אֶל־פְּנֵי־אֹ֨רֶךְ֙ אַמּ֣וֹת הַמֵּאָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח הַצָּפ֑וֹן וְהָרֹ֖חַב חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמּֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: To [the] face of [the] length of a hundred cubits [was] [the] entrance of the north, and the breadth fifty cubits.

en.L: Along the front, the length [was] a hundred cubits, [with] the entrance on the north, and the width [was] fifty cubits.
en.B: The building with the north entrance was {{units:about 175 feet|100 cubits}} long and {{units:about 87 1/2 feet|fifty cubits}} wide.
en.R: The building had its entrance on the north side. It was {{units:about 175 feet|100 cubits}} long and {{units:about 87 1/2 feet|fifty cubits}} wide.

pt.L: Ao longo da frente, o comprimento [era] de cem côvados, [com] a entrada no norte, e a largura [era] de cinquenta côvados.
pt.B: O edifício com a entrada no norte tinha {{units:cerca de 52,5 metros|cem côvados}} de comprimento e {{units:cerca de 26 metros|cinquenta côvados}} de largura.
pt.R: O edifício tinha a sua entrada no lado norte. Tinha {{units:cerca de 52,5 metros|cem côvados}} de comprimento e {{units:cerca de 26 metros|cinquenta côvados}} de largura.

decisions.choice: the length of a hundred cubits ... the entrance of the north: the front of the block of rooms
decisions.reason: The words are compressed. They give the length of the block of rooms (a hundred cubits), with its door on the north, and its depth (fifty cubits).

source.text: נֶ֣גֶד הָֽעֶשְׂרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֙ לֶחָצֵ֣ר הַפְּנִימִ֔י וְנֶ֣גֶד רִֽצְפָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֶחָצֵ֣ר הַחִֽיצוֹנָ֑ה אַתִּ֥יק אֶל־פְּנֵֽי־אַתִּ֖יק בַּשְּׁלִשִֽׁים׃

records.literal_gloss: Opposite the twenty which [belonged] to the court the inner and opposite [the] pavement which [belonged] to the court the outer, gallery to [the] face of gallery in [the] third [story].

en.L: Facing the twenty [cubits] of the inner court and facing the pavement of the outer court, [there was] gallery facing gallery in three stories.
en.B: It stood between the space of {{units:about 35 feet|twenty cubits}} that belonged to the inner court and the pavement of the outer court, with gallery facing gallery on three levels.
en.R: On one side was the open space {{units:about 35 feet|twenty cubits}} wide next to the inner courtyard. On the other side was the pavement of the outer courtyard. The building had galleries facing each other on three levels.

pt.L: Defronte dos vinte [côvados] do átrio interior e defronte do pavimento do átrio exterior, [havia] galeria defronte de galeria, em três andares.
pt.B: Ele ficava entre o espaço de {{units:cerca de 10,5 metros|vinte côvados}} que pertencia ao átrio interior e o pavimento do átrio exterior, com galeria defronte de galeria em três andares.
pt.R: De um lado ficava o espaço livre de {{units:cerca de 10,5 metros|vinte côvados}} de largura junto ao pátio interno. Do outro lado ficava o piso de pedra do pátio externo. O edifício tinha galerias, umas de frente para as outras, em três andares.

decisions.choice: the twenty: the open space of twenty cubits around the temple building
decisions.reason: "The twenty" refers to the space twenty cubits wide between the temple building and the rooms (41:10).

decisions.choice: gallery facing gallery in three stories: a hard phrase
decisions.reason: The word for gallery is the uncertain word of 41:15-16. The rooms seem to have been in three stories, stepped back, with galleries or terraces facing one another. The details are not clear.

decisions.choice: galleries (all levels)
decisions.reason: As in 41:15.

source.text: וְלִפְנֵ֨י הַלְּשָׁכ֜וֹת מַהֲלַךְ֩ עֶ֨שֶׂר אַמּ֥וֹת רֹ֨חַב֙ אֶל־הַפְּנִימִ֔ית דֶּ֖רֶךְ אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת וּפִתְחֵיהֶ֖ם לַצָּפֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And before the rooms [was] a walkway of ten cubits breadth to the inner, a way of one cubit; and their entrances [were] to the north.

en.L: And in front of the chambers [was] a walkway, ten cubits wide, to the inside, a way of one cubit; and their doors [faced] north.
en.B: In front of the rooms, on the inner side, was a passage {{units:about 17 1/2 feet|ten cubits}} wide, a way of {{units:about 21 inches|a cubit}}. Their doors faced north.
en.R: In front of the rooms, on the inner side, was a walkway {{units:about 17 1/2 feet|ten cubits}} wide, with a path of {{units:about 21 inches|a cubit}}. The doors of the rooms faced north.

pt.L: E diante das câmaras [havia] uma passagem de dez côvados de largura, para o interior, um caminho de um côvado; e as suas portas [davam] para o norte.
pt.B: Diante das salas, do lado de dentro, havia uma passagem de {{units:cerca de 5,25 metros|dez côvados}} de largura, um caminho de {{units:cerca de 52,5 centímetros|um côvado}}. As suas portas davam para o norte.
pt.R: Na frente das salas, do lado de dentro, havia uma passagem de {{units:cerca de 5,25 metros|dez côvados}} de largura, com um caminho de {{units:cerca de 52,5 centímetros|um côvado}}. As portas das salas davam para o norte.

decisions.choice: a way of one cubit: the Septuagint reads "a hundred cubits long"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "a way of one cubit" makes little sense for a walkway ten cubits wide. The Septuagint and the Syriac read "a length of a hundred cubits", which matches the length of the building (verse 2). The translation keeps the Hebrew, whose meaning here is unclear.

source.text: וְהַלְּשָׁכ֥וֹת הָעֶלְיוֹנֹ֖ת קְצֻר֑וֹת כִּֽי־יוֹכְל֨וּ אַתִּיקִ֜ים מֵהֵ֗נָה מֵֽהַתַּחְתֹּנ֛וֹת וּמֵהַתִּֽכֹנ֖וֹת בִּנְיָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And the rooms the upper [were] short, for [the] galleries took away from them more than from the lower and from the middle of [the] building.

en.L: And the upper chambers [were] shorter, for the galleries took [space] from them, more than from the lower and from the middle [chambers] of the building.
en.B: The upper rooms were narrower, because the galleries took more space from them than from the rooms on the lower and middle floors of the building.
en.R: The rooms on the top level were narrower than those on the lower and middle levels. This was because the galleries took up more space on the top level.

pt.L: E as câmaras superiores [eram] mais estreitas, pois as galerias tiravam [espaço] delas, mais do que das de baixo e das do meio do edifício.
pt.B: As salas de cima eram mais estreitas, porque as galerias tiravam delas mais espaço do que das salas dos andares de baixo e do meio do edifício.
pt.R: As salas do último andar eram mais estreitas que as dos andares de baixo e do meio. Isso acontecia porque as galerias ocupavam mais espaço no último andar.

source.text: כִּ֤י מְשֻׁלָּשׁוֹת֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְאֵ֤ין לָהֶן֙ עַמּוּדִ֔ים כְּעַמּוּדֵ֖י הַחֲצֵר֑וֹת עַל־כֵּ֣ן נֶאֱצַ֗ל מֵהַתַּחְתּוֹנ֛וֹת וּמֵהַתִּֽיכֹנ֖וֹת מֵהָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: For they [were] in three [stories], and to them [there were] no pillars like [the] pillars of the courts; therefore it was set back from the lower and from the middle from the ground.

en.L: For they [were] in three stories, and they had no pillars like the pillars of the courts; therefore [the upper story] was set back, more than the lower and the middle, from the ground.
en.B: The rooms were on three floors and had no pillars, as the courts had. So the top floor was set back more than the lower and middle floors.
en.R: The rooms were on three levels, and they had no pillars like the courtyards had. So the top level was set back farther than the lower and middle levels.

pt.L: Pois [estavam] em três andares e não tinham colunas como as colunas dos átrios; por isso [o andar de cima] era recuado, mais do que o de baixo e o do meio, a partir do chão.
pt.B: As salas ficavam em três andares e não tinham colunas, como as dos átrios. Por isso o andar de cima era mais recuado que os andares de baixo e do meio.
pt.R: As salas ficavam em três andares e não tinham colunas como as dos pátios. Por isso o último andar ficava mais para trás que os andares de baixo e do meio.

decisions.choice: no pillars like the pillars of the courts: the upper stories rested on the ones below
decisions.reason: With no pillars to carry them, the upper floors had to be built in steps, each set back from the one below. This is why the upper rooms were smaller. The "pillars of the courts" are not otherwise described.

source.text: וְגָדֵ֤ר אֲשֶׁר־לַחוּץ֙ לְעֻמַּ֣ת הַלְּשָׁכ֔וֹת דֶּ֛רֶךְ הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַחִֽצוֹנָ֖ה אֶל־פְּנֵ֣י הַלְּשָׁכ֑וֹת אָרְכּ֖וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And a wall which [was] outside, alongside the rooms, [the] way of the court the outer, to [the] face of the rooms, its length fifty cubits.

en.L: And [there was] a wall outside, alongside the chambers, toward the outer court, in front of the chambers; its length [was] fifty cubits.
en.B: There was an outer wall parallel to the rooms, on the side toward the outer court, in front of the rooms. It was {{units:about 87 1/2 feet|fifty cubits}} long.
en.R: There was a wall outside, running alongside the rooms on the side toward the outer courtyard. It was {{units:about 87 1/2 feet|fifty cubits}} long.

pt.L: E [havia] um muro do lado de fora, ao longo das câmaras, para o lado do átrio exterior, diante das câmaras; o seu comprimento [era] de cinquenta côvados.
pt.B: Havia um muro externo paralelo às salas, do lado do átrio exterior, diante das salas. Ele tinha {{units:cerca de 26 metros|cinquenta côvados}} de comprimento.
pt.R: Do lado de fora havia um muro que corria ao longo das salas, do lado do pátio externo. Ele tinha {{units:cerca de 26 metros|cinquenta côvados}} de comprimento.

decisions.choice: a wall: a screening wall
decisions.reason: The wall probably screened the rooms from the outer court, so that the holy rooms could not be seen into from where the people gathered.

source.text: כִּֽי־אֹ֣רֶךְ הַלְּשָׁכ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֶחָצֵ֥ר הַחִֽצוֹנָ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַהֵיכָ֖ל מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For [the] length of the rooms which [belonged] to the court the outer [was] fifty cubits; and look, on [the] face of the temple, a hundred cubits.

en.L: For the length of the chambers that [belonged] to the outer court [was] fifty cubits; and look, [those] facing the hall [were] a hundred cubits.
en.B: The rooms on the side of the outer court were {{units:about 87 1/2 feet|fifty cubits}} long, while those facing the temple were {{units:about 175 feet|100 cubits}} long.
en.R: The rooms on the side toward the outer courtyard were {{units:about 87 1/2 feet|fifty cubits}} long. The rooms facing the temple were {{units:about 175 feet|100 cubits}} long.

pt.L: Pois o comprimento das câmaras que [pertenciam] ao átrio exterior [era] de cinquenta côvados; e eis [que as] que ficavam defronte do salão [tinham] cem côvados.
pt.B: As salas do lado do átrio exterior tinham {{units:cerca de 26 metros|cinquenta côvados}} de comprimento, enquanto as que ficavam defronte do templo tinham {{units:cerca de 52,5 metros|cem côvados}} de comprimento.
pt.R: As salas do lado do pátio externo tinham {{units:cerca de 26 metros|cinquenta côvados}} de comprimento. As salas que ficavam de frente para o templo tinham {{units:cerca de 52,5 metros|cem côvados}} de comprimento.

decisions.choice: fifty cubits ... a hundred cubits: two rows of rooms of different length
decisions.reason: The block seems to have had two rows: an outer row fifty cubits long toward the outer court, and an inner row a hundred cubits long facing the temple.

decisions.choice: the temple (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word is the one for the main hall (41:1), but here it means the temple building as a whole.

source.text: וּמִתַּ֖חַת הַלְּשָׁכ֣וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה הַמֵּבִיא֙ מֵֽהַקָּדִ֔ים בְּבֹא֣וֹ לָהֵ֔נָּה מֵֽהֶחָצֵ֖ר הַחִצֹנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And from under these rooms [was] the entrance from the east, when one comes to them from the court the outer.

en.L: And below these chambers [was] the entrance on the east, as one comes to them from the outer court.
en.B: Below these rooms was an entrance on the east side, for those going into them from the outer court.
en.R: On the lower level, the rooms had an entrance on the east side. People came in there from the outer courtyard.

pt.L: E por baixo destas câmaras [havia] a entrada do lado do oriente, para quem vem a elas do átrio exterior.
pt.B: Embaixo dessas salas havia uma entrada no lado leste, para quem entrava nelas vindo do átrio exterior.
pt.R: No andar de baixo, as salas tinham uma entrada no lado leste. As pessoas entravam por ali, vindas do pátio externo.

decisions.choice: from under ... the one bringing in: the written text and the reading tradition differ
decisions.reason: The words "from under" and "the entrance" are read differently in the written Hebrew text and in the tradition of how it is read aloud. The sense is the same either way: the entrance to the rooms was on the east, from the outer court.

source.text: בְּרֹ֣חַב׀גֶּ֣דֶר הֶחָצֵ֗ר דֶּ֧רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֛ים אֶל־פְּנֵ֧י הַגִּזְרָ֛ה וְאֶל־פְּנֵ֥י הַבִּנְיָ֖ן לְשָׁכֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: In [the] breadth of [the] wall of the court [the] way of the east, to [the] face of the separate area and to [the] face of the building, rooms.

en.L: In the breadth of the court's wall, toward the east, facing the separate area and facing the building, [were] chambers.
en.B: Along the wall of the court, starting from the east, facing the separate area and the building, there were rooms too.
en.R: Along the wall of the courtyard, starting at the east end, there were more rooms. They faced the separate area and the building.

pt.L: Na largura do muro do átrio, para o lado do oriente, defronte da área separada e defronte do edifício, [havia] câmaras.
pt.B: Ao longo do muro do átrio, a partir do leste, defronte da área separada e do edifício, também havia salas.
pt.R: Ao longo do muro do pátio, a partir do lado leste, havia mais salas. Elas ficavam de frente para a área separada e para o edifício.

decisions.choice: toward the east: the rooms on the south side
decisions.reason: The rooms described in verses 10-12 match those on the north (verses 1-9) and are on the south side of the temple, as verse 12 and verse 13 say. The Septuagint reads "toward the south" here. The translation keeps the Hebrew and takes "toward the east" as the direction in which the wall and its rooms run.

decisions.choice: starting from the east (B); starting at the east end (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "the way of the east" is taken as the direction in which the row of rooms runs (m1).

source.text: וְדֶ֨רֶךְ֙ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם כְּמַרְאֵ֣ה הַלְּשָׁכ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁר֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן כְּאָרְכָּ֖ן כֵּ֣ן רָחְבָּ֑ן וְכֹל֙ מוֹצָ֣אֵיהֶ֔ן וּכְמִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶ֖ן וּכְפִתְחֵיהֶֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And a way [was] before them like [the] appearance of the rooms which [were] [the] way of the north, like their length so their breadth, and all their exits and like their plans and like their entrances.

en.L: And a walkway [was] in front of them, like the appearance of the chambers that [were] toward the north; as their length, so their width, and all their exits and their arrangements and their entrances.
en.B: There was a passage in front of them. They looked like the rooms on the north side: they were the same length and width, with the same exits, the same plan and the same doors.
en.R: There was a walkway in front of them. These rooms looked just like the rooms on the north side. They were the same length and width. Their exits, their layout and their doors were the same.

pt.L: E [havia] uma passagem diante delas, como a aparência das câmaras que [ficavam] para o lado do norte; como o seu comprimento, assim a sua largura, e todas as suas saídas, e as suas disposições, e as suas entradas.
pt.B: Havia uma passagem diante delas. Elas se pareciam com as salas do lado norte: tinham o mesmo comprimento e a mesma largura, as mesmas saídas, a mesma planta e as mesmas portas.
pt.R: Havia uma passagem na frente delas. Essas salas eram iguais às salas do lado norte. Tinham o mesmo comprimento e a mesma largura. As suas saídas, a sua planta e as suas portas eram iguais.

decisions.choice: plans: arrangements or regulations
decisions.reason: The word usually means "judgments" or "rules", but here it is used of the layout of the rooms, their arrangement.

source.text: וּכְפִתְחֵ֣י הַלְּשָׁכ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁר֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֔וֹם פֶּ֖תַח בְּרֹ֣אשׁ דָּ֑רֶךְ דֶּ֗רֶךְ בִּפְנֵי֙ הַגְּדֶ֣רֶת הֲגִינָ֔ה דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֖ים בְּבוֹאָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And like [the] entrances of the rooms which [were] [the] way of the south, an entrance at [the] head of a way, a way before the wall corresponding, [the] way of the east, as one comes to them.

en.L: And like the entrances of the chambers that [were] toward the south, [there was] an entrance at the head of the walkway, the walkway in front of the corresponding wall, toward the east, as one enters them.
en.B: The rooms on the south side had a door like these, at the head of the passage that ran in front of the matching wall on the east, for those going in.
en.R: These rooms on the south side had doors like those on the north side. There was a doorway at the beginning of the walkway, beside the matching wall, on the east side, where people came in.

pt.L: E como as entradas das câmaras que [ficavam] para o lado do sul, [havia] uma entrada no começo da passagem, a passagem diante do muro correspondente, para o lado do oriente, para quem entra nelas.
pt.B: As salas do lado sul tinham uma porta igual a essas, no começo da passagem que corria diante do muro correspondente, no lado leste, para quem entrava.
pt.R: Essas salas do lado sul tinham portas iguais às do lado norte. Havia uma entrada no começo da passagem, junto ao muro correspondente, no lado leste, por onde as pessoas entravam.

decisions.choice: a difficult verse: the entrance of the southern rooms matches the northern
decisions.reason: The words are very compressed and may be damaged. Their general sense is that the southern rooms had an entrance on the east, like the northern ones (verse 9). The word translated "corresponding" is found only here.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י לִֽשְׁכ֨וֹת הַצָּפ֜וֹן לִֽשְׁכ֣וֹת הַדָּרוֹם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶל־פְּנֵ֣י הַגִּזְרָה֒ הֵ֣נָּה׀לִֽשְׁכ֣וֹת הַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֹאכְלוּ־שָׁ֧ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־קְרוֹבִ֥ים לַֽיהוָ֖ה קָדְשֵׁ֣י הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים שָׁ֞ם יַנִּ֣יחוּ׀קָדְשֵׁ֣י הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים וְהַמִּנְחָה֙ וְהַחַטָּ֣את וְהָאָשָׁ֔ם כִּ֥י הַמָּק֖וֹם קָדֹֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to me, [The] rooms of the north, [the] rooms of the south which [are] to [the] face of the separate area, they [are] [the] rooms of holiness where the priests who [are] near to Yahweh will eat the most holy things; there they will set down the most holy things, and the grain offering and the sin offering and the guilt offering, for the place [is] holy.

en.L: And he said to me, "The north chambers [and] the south chambers that [are] facing the separate area, they [are] the holy chambers where the priests who are near to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will eat the most holy things. There they will lay the most holy things, the grain offering, the sin offering and the guilt offering, for the place [is] holy.
en.B: He said to me, "The north rooms and the south rooms that face the separate area are the holy rooms where the priests who come near to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will eat the most holy offerings. There they will put the most holy offerings: the grain offering, the sin offering and the guilt offering, for the place is holy.
en.R: The man said to me, "The rooms on the north and on the south that face the separate area are holy rooms. The priests who serve near {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will eat the most holy offerings there. They will also keep the most holy offerings there: the grain offerings, the sin offerings and the guilt offerings. They must be kept there because the place is holy.

pt.L: E ele me disse: "As câmaras do norte [e] as câmaras do sul, que [estão] defronte da área separada, elas [são] as câmaras santas, onde os sacerdotes que se aproximam {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} comerão as coisas santíssimas. Ali porão as coisas santíssimas: a oferta de cereal, e a oferta pelo pecado, e a oferta pela culpa, pois o lugar [é] santo.
pt.B: Ele me disse: "As salas do norte e as salas do sul, que ficam defronte da área separada, são as salas santas, onde os sacerdotes que se aproximam {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} comerão as ofertas santíssimas. Ali porão as ofertas santíssimas: a oferta de cereal, a oferta pelo pecado e a oferta pela culpa, pois o lugar é santo.
pt.R: O homem me disse: "As salas do norte e do sul que ficam de frente para a área separada são salas santas. Os sacerdotes que servem perto {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} vão comer ali as ofertas santíssimas. Também vão guardar ali as ofertas santíssimas: as ofertas de cereal, as ofertas pelo pecado e as ofertas pela culpa. Elas devem ficar ali porque o lugar é santo.

decisions.choice: the most holy things: the parts of the offerings given to the priests
decisions.reason: The law gave the priests a share of the grain offering, the sin offering and the guilt offering, to be eaten in a holy place, because these were "most holy" (Leviticus 6:9-11, 18-22; 7:6; Numbers 18:9-10). Ezekiel's temple provides rooms for this. The same rule returns in 44:29 and 46:20.

decisions.choice: the priests who are near to the LORD: the priests who serve at the altar
decisions.reason: The phrase recalls 40:46 and 43:19: those of the sons of Zadok who come near the LORD to serve him.

decisions.choice: the most holy offerings (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "the most holy things". Balanced and Readable say what they are (m1).

decisions.choice: They must be kept there because (R)
decisions.reason: Readable makes the reason explicit.

decisions.choice: as coisas santíssimas (L); as ofertas santíssimas (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "most holy things", Balanced and Readable say what they are, as the English; "santíssimo" is the word of "o Lugar Santíssimo", so the link between the holiest place and the holiest offerings is kept.

source.text: בְּבֹאָ֣ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וְלֹֽא־יֵצְא֤וּ מֵהַקֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ אֶל־הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַחִיצוֹנָ֔ה וְשָׁ֞ם יַנִּ֧יחוּ בִגְדֵיהֶ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־יְשָׁרְת֥וּ בָהֶ֖ן כִּֽי־קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֑נָּה וְלָבְשׁוּ֙ בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְקָרְב֖וּ אֶל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: When the priests go in, they will not go out from the holy place into the court the outer, and there they will set down their garments in which they serve, for they [are] holy; and they will put on other garments and draw near to what [is] for the people.

en.L: When the priests enter, they shall not go out from the holy place into the outer court; and there they shall lay their garments in which they minister, for they [are] holy; and they shall clothe themselves in other garments and [then] approach what [is] for the people."
en.B: Once the priests have gone in, they are not to go out from the holy area into the outer court without leaving there the garments in which they serve, for these are holy. They must change into other clothes before they go near the area for the people."
en.R: When the priests have entered the holy area, they must not go straight out into the outer courtyard. First they must take off the clothes they wore while they served, because these clothes are holy. They must leave them in these rooms. Then they must put on other clothes before they go near the area where the people are."

pt.L: Quando os sacerdotes entrarem, não sairão do lugar santo para o átrio exterior; e ali deixarão as suas vestes com que ministram, pois elas [são] santas; e vestirão outras vestes e [então] se aproximarão do que [é] do povo."
pt.B: Depois de entrarem, os sacerdotes não sairão do lugar santo para o átrio exterior sem deixar ali as vestes com que servem, pois elas são santas. Eles deverão trocar de roupa antes de se aproximarem da área do povo."
pt.R: Quando os sacerdotes tiverem entrado na área santa, não poderão sair direto para o pátio externo. Primeiro devem tirar as roupas que usaram para servir, porque essas roupas são santas. Devem deixá-las nessas salas. Depois devem vestir outras roupas antes de se aproximarem da área onde está o povo."

decisions.choice: for they are holy: holiness could pass from holy things to what touched them
decisions.reason: The priests' garments had been in contact with the most holy things. They had to be left in the holy rooms so that holiness would not pass to the people in the outer court (44:19; 46:20). The temple is laid out to keep the holy and the common apart (verse 20; 22:26).

decisions.choice: without leaving there the garments (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced joins the two halves of the rule into one sentence; the sense is that the priests may go out only after leaving their holy garments.

source.text: וְכִלָּ֗ה אֶת־מִדּוֹת֙ הַבַּ֣יִת הַפְּנִימִ֔י וְהוֹצִיאַ֨נִי֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַשַּׁ֔עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֑ים וּמְדָד֖וֹ סָבִ֥יב׀סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And he finished [the] measurements of the house the inner, and he brought me out [the] way of the gate whose face [is] [the] way of the east, and he measured it all around all around.

en.L: And he finished the measurements of the inner house, and brought me out by way of the gate that faces toward the east, and he measured it all around.
en.B: When he had finished measuring the inner area of the temple, he led me out by the gate that faces east and measured the whole area around it.
en.R: When the man had finished measuring the inside of the temple area, he led me out through the east gate. Then he measured the whole area around it.

pt.L: E ele terminou as medições da casa interior, e me fez sair pelo caminho da porta que olha para o lado do oriente, e a mediu ao redor.
pt.B: Quando terminou de medir a área interna do templo, ele me levou para fora pela porta que dá para o leste e mediu toda a área em volta.
pt.R: Quando o homem terminou de medir a parte de dentro da área do templo, ele me levou para fora pela porta leste. Depois mediu toda a área em volta.

decisions.choice: he measured it all around: the whole temple area, from outside
decisions.reason: Having measured the gates, courts and buildings from inside, the guide now measures the outer wall of the whole complex on its four sides (verses 16-20).

en.L: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, 500 reeds by the measuring reed all around.
en.B: He measured the east side with the measuring reed: it was {{units:about a mile|500 reeds}} by the measuring reed.
en.R: He measured the east side with his measuring stick. It was {{units:about a mile|500 reeds}} long.

pt.L: Mediu o lado do oriente com a cana de medir: quinhentas canas, pela cana de medir, ao redor.
pt.B: Ele mediu o lado leste com a cana de medir: tinha {{units:cerca de 1,6 quilômetro|quinhentas canas}}, pela cana de medir.
pt.R: Ele mediu o lado leste com a sua vara de medir. Tinha {{units:cerca de 1,6 quilômetro|quinhentas canas}} de comprimento.

decisions.choice: 500 reeds: the Septuagint has "500 cubits"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "500 reeds" (here by the reading tradition; the written text of this verse appears to have a word for "cubits" in place of "hundred"). The Septuagint has "500 cubits" in verse 17. 500 reeds is about a mile, far larger than the walls and courts measured in chapters 40-42, which come to about 500 cubits on each side (about 880 feet). So many think "cubits" is the original reading. The translation follows the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: the east side: literally "the east wind"
decisions.reason: The word for "side" here is the word for wind or breath, used of the four directions (as 37:9).

decisions.choice: {{units:about a mile|500 reeds}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: On the reed of six long cubits (40:5).

decisions.choice: {{units:cerca de 1,6 quilômetro|quinhentas canas}}
decisions.reason: Metric by default, as set at 40:5: five hundred reeds of six long cubits are about 1,6 kilometres, where the English gives "about a mile"; Literal keeps the reeds, with the number in words as in 1 Kings.

en.L: On [all] four sides he measured it. It had a wall all around, 500 long and 500 wide, to separate the holy from the common.
en.B: He measured it on all four sides. It had a wall all around it, {{units:about a mile|500 reeds}} long and {{units:about a mile|500 reeds}} wide, to separate what was holy from what was common.
en.R: He measured it on all four sides. A wall went all the way around it. It was {{units:about a mile|500 reeds}} long and {{units:about a mile|500 reeds}} wide. The wall separated what was holy from what was not holy.

pt.B: Ele a mediu pelos quatro lados. Ela tinha um muro em toda a volta, com {{units:cerca de 1,6 quilômetro|quinhentas canas}} de comprimento e {{units:cerca de 1,6 quilômetro|quinhentas canas}} de largura, para separar o que era santo do que era comum.
pt.R: Ele a mediu pelos quatro lados. Um muro passava por toda a volta. Tinha {{units:cerca de 1,6 quilômetro|quinhentas canas}} de comprimento e {{units:cerca de 1,6 quilômetro|quinhentas canas}} de largura. O muro separava o que era santo do que não era santo.

decisions.choice: to separate the holy from the common: the purpose of the whole design
decisions.reason: The priests were charged to teach the difference between the holy and the common (Leviticus 10:10), and Ezekiel accused them of failing to do so (22:26; see 44:23). The wall around the temple makes the distinction visible. In Revelation 21:12-17 the holy city has a great wall and is measured as a square.

decisions.choice: 500 long and 500 wide: no unit is given
decisions.reason: The verse gives the numbers without a unit; the unit of verses 16-19 (reeds, or cubits in the Greek) is understood.

decisions.choice: {{units:about a mile|500 reeds}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The unit is supplied from verses 16-19 (m2).
